name: Lithuania
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national and European Parliament roll call; register = 10 apskritys (ISO 3166-2) and 60 savivaldybės (LAU). First pass R001 (2026-11-04). Lithuania's 2021 turto mokestis is a tax on high-value real estate, now the Nekilnojamojo turto mokestis (new law from 2026), so it is excluded as a property-only tax; no net-wealth-tax proposal was found in the Seimas. Map: Eurostat GISCO LAU 2024 (units) and NUTS 2024 level 3 (regions), CC BY 4.0, codes are Eurostat LAU codes (units). Seats tab: Seimas (141 seats) from the Seimas open data; two register supporters sit (Olekas, Ropė).
